dialog_pre_install_generic_tip:
• Fumyeni amaka yonse ku cipe cenu ica MediaTek.
• Sunga intambo ya USB iyaputulwa pali nomba.
• Ukulingana ne misango, esheniko ukubikako nelyo ukwabula ukubikwamo battery (nelyo ukukakatika Iciunda Panshi / Pamulu ilyo mulebika).
• Tinikeni pa Twalilileni, lyene lunganika intambo ya USB nga mwapeelwa.

dialog_pre_install_innioasis_tip:
• Fumyeni amaka ya cibombelo cenu fyonse ilyo tamulatendeka.
• Nga ca kuti icipe cafiita nelyo tacilebomba, bomfyeni pini nelyo icipe ca kufimbapo amapepala mu cishima ca kubweshapo pa kuti mupatikishe amaka ukuleka ukubomba mu musango wa kusendamapo.
• Sunga intambo ya USB iyaputulwa pali nomba.
• Tinikeni pa Twalilileni, lyene lunganika ifipe fyenu ukupitila muli USB nga mwapeelwa.

err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Fayelo ya kushininkisha iyo mwasalile tayasangwa, tayakwata nangu tekuti ilembelwe. Saleni fayelo iyalinga, nangu ukuifumya mu Fibikilwepo, lyena ubwelelemo na kabili.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Fayilo ya fibombelo fyakubikamo ifyakubikamo tayasangwa. Saleni Salenipo Sofutiweya pakuti mubuule cipya cipya amafailo ayafumishiwapo nangu ukusenda na kabili ifyakubikamo ifyakubomfya. Ubu bwafya bwa failo ya mu ncende, te bwafya bwa kulanshanya kwa USB.
err_checksum_stall_no_sp_desc: Ukushininkisha kwaimikwa ilyo kwalemweka. Mukwai bwekeshenipo ukubelenga no kwesha nakabili.
err_checksum_stall_sp_failover: Ukushininkisha kwaimikwa ilyo kwalepepa na {failed}. Tulepanda amano ukwesha na kabili na {next} pa {model} yenu.
err_code_missing_images: Ifikope fya programu wa kompyuta ifibulile mu cipe
err_code_partition_table_invalid: Ukushininkisha kwa tebulo lya kwakanishiwa kwafilwa panuma ya kulemba
err_code_sp_not_found: Icibombelo ca SP ica kulanga tacisangilwe
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Iciputulwa ca USB COM tacali no kwisulwa (ukulufyanya 1013). Ukutendeka cipyacipya kompyuta yenu kukafumyapo icifulo icakakilwe. Mukwai bwekeshenipo kompyuta yenu no kwesha nakabili.
err_connect_failover_recovery:
{failed} tekuti ilunde ku {model} yenu.

Uwabwekeshapo nomba akaesha {next} mu cifulo cakwe.

Mukwai fumyeni USB no kubomfya icikope ca mapepala / pin ku kutinika batani pa kati ka cifulo ca ku matwi ne cifulo ca USB, lyena tinikeni pa cikonkelepo.
err_connection_failed_desc: Tacingapanga ukumfwana ukwashintilila na kalemba. Shininkisheni ukuti icipe calicimfiwa (bomfyeni pin ku kutinika batani lya kubwesha nga cakabilwa), fumyeni USB, no kubweshapo nga mwapeelwa.
err_driver_missing_desc: Uku kulufyanya kuti kwacitika nga ca kuti umubomfi wa USB uwa MediaTek tabikwa. Tinikeni pa kuti mubike ifibombelo fya MediaTek USB, mutendeke kompyuta yenu, kabili muleesha na kabili.
err_driver_missing_title: Umubomfi wa USB uwa mishiwile alefwaikwa
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Ukumwentula kwalepumfyanishiwa nangu umulimo wa kulemba walifililwe. Moneni nga ca kuti intambo ya USB yalibikwa bwino kabili battery yalikwata amaka ayalinga, lyene esheniko na kabili.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Ubwafya ubushicetekelwe bwacitike ilyo balebika ({detail}). Zima fyonse ifyakubelenga, bwekeshepo nga wapeelwa, kabili esheniko nakabili.
err_keep_data_failed: Teti musunge imitantikile yenu ne fyakushimikila: icibikilo ca fibombelo tacilembwa. Tapali icabikwepo.
err_missing_package_files_desc: Iciputulwa ca kompyuta tacikwetemo failo ya kusansalikwa nelyo amafailo ya fikope ayafwaikwa. Mukwai bwekeshapo ukusenda ifipe nangu saleni failo iyakumanina iya programu.
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Icibombelo ca kufimbapo calangisha umutande umo wine pa masekondi {seconds} aya kulekelesha kabili tacilemoneka ukuti cilatwalilila ukulemba ifya kupangapanga. Flash kuti yafilwa ukubomba. Nga ca kuti ici cali ca kulekelesha pa kwesha kwabili ne nshila imo imo pa nshita iyo kuti yabwelela ku numa pa kati kabo, nelyo nga ca kuti fye MTKClient e walipo pali iyi mashini, bwekeshapo kompyuta no kwesha na kabili.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Iyi kompyuta kuti na kabili yabika ukubomfya Icibombelo ca SP. Nga kuti mwacita, cinjeni ku Cibombelo ca SP no kwesha na kabili.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: MTKClient fye eulipo kuli uku kubika. Flash kuti yafilwa ukubomba. Mukwai bwekeshepo kompyuta no kwesha nakabili.
err_pmt_format_required_desc: Icipe ca SP ica kufwailako calilandile ukuti tebulo lya kupaatukanya ilya kwa kalemba lyalyalwike (8502). Iyi programu ifwile ukubikwa mu musango wa Kupanga Fyonse + Ukukopolola, uupanga cipya cipya ifya kusunga ifya mukati.
err_restart_flash: Tampa nakabili flash ukufuma pa kutendeka
err_sp_brom_da_fail: Umubomfi wa kusendapo tekuti atuminwe ku cakutambishishapo. Imiteni amaka no kuilungamika nakabili.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Kaseebanya alipokele amaka bwangu bwangu. Ukucizima fyonse, lyena ukucibika na kabili.
err_sp_com_port: Ici cibombelo tacakwete amaka ya kwisula icifulo ca ciko. Isaleni ifibombelo fimbi ifya kulanga no kufibika nakabili.
err_sp_da_init_sync: Umubomfi wa ku kopolola tekuti atendeke. Esheniko inshila imbi iya kufimbilikisha.
err_sp_da_invalid_type: Kaseebanya alikeene umubomfi wa kusenda (ukulufyanya 6104). Bomfyeni Umubomfi wa Kukopolola uwabikwa pamo ne Cibombelo ca SP Flash, kabili moneni nga ca kutila programu wa pa kompyuta aleumfwana na uyu umubomfi.
err_sp_download_fail: Ukulemba kwaliputulwe. Moneni intambo ya USB ne cifulo ca kufimbapo ne fyo battery yaba, lyena esheniko na kabili.
err_sp_enable_dram: Ici cibombelo tacali no kutendeka ukubuuka kwa kalemba. Bomfyeni icipe icapangwa kuli iyi mibele ine ine.
err_sp_storage_read: Ici cibombelo tacali no kubelenga ifyo umutambishi asungile. Moneni ukukumanina; icipe kuti cakwata ububi bwa cibombelo.
err_sp_timeout: Icibombelo tacamwenepo umusambi. Ukucisunga icaimikwa no kucifumya, lyene lunganika intambo ya USB nga mwapeelwa.
err_sp_wrong_model: Mwasuntinkanya umusango wa katamba uwabipa. Tinikeni pe batani lya × pa kuti mufumyepo uku kubika, lyena saleni programu wa citabo ico mwabika.
err_storage_full_desc: Kompyuta yenu naipwisha incende ya kusungilamo. Mukwai fumyeni incende pali disk yenu no kwesha nakabili.
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Icibombelo icakumwentula nangu abakutwala inshila balekabila tekuti batendeke. Mukwai moneni insambu sha mibombele, imitantikile ya bakwesha, nangula ukubikamo cipyacipya ububomfi.
err_usb_bus_down_recovery: macOS tekuti imone icibombelo ca USB icili conse pali ino nshita, eico {model} yenu tekuti ifikepo. Ukufumyapo icipe ca kutambapo ne cifulo ca USB icili conse nelyo icifulo ca kufimbapo, lyena bwekeshepo Mac - umubomfi wa USB alekabila ukutendeka kwa maka ilyo ukubika kumbi takulatendeka.
err_usb_disconnected_recovery: {model} yenu yaliputulwa. Mukwai fumyeni USB no kubomfya icikope ca mapepala / pin ku kutinika batani pa kati ka cifulo ca ku matwi ne cifulo ca USB, lyena tinikeni pa cikonkelepo.

flash_close_confirm: Bushe nashininkisha ukuti mulefwaya ukuleka ukubika no kwisala {app}?

1. Saleni 'Inshila ya Kusungilamo USB' pa cipe cenu.
2. Tinikeni 'Fwayeni Folda...' pa kusalapo umutambishi wenu no kubikamo imitwe.
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_other: Fumyeni USB no kubika amaka pa {model} yenu, lyena tinikeni pa Kukonkapo.
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_y1: Fumyeni USB no kupanga amaka pa Y1 yenu, lyena tinikeni Next.
rockbox_recover_troubleshoot: Bushe icibombelo taciletendeka? Bwesheni sofutiweya iyakubalilapo
rockbox_site_themes_note: Ici cibumba ca mabwe cibomfya imitwe 240×320, iyo iishibikwe pamo. Pokeni imitwe iyabula ukulipila iyakutambisha kwenu ukufuma pa ncende ya mitwe ya Rockbox:
rockbox_site_themes_open: Isuleni incende ya mutwe wa kabokoshi ka mabwe
rockbox_stage_disconnect_extra: Abasambi ukucila pali umo balisuntinkanishiwa. Ukufumyapo fimbi no kuleka fye ifyo balebika.
rockbox_stage_installing: Ukubika imitwe ya mabwe na ma fonti...
rockbox_stage_pushing: Kateya asangilwe. Ukubika imitwe ya cikaya na ma fonti...
rockbox_step1_disconnect_power_on: Mukwai fumyenipo no kusonkela {model} yenu, lyena tinikeni Icakonkapo
rockbox_step1_power_on_button: Ukufumyapo USB, ukusenda {button} pa kuti {model} yobe ibombe, lyena tinikeni pa Kukonkapo.
rockbox_step2_connect_usb: Mukwai lunganika {model} yenu ukupitila muli USB
rockbox_step_select_player_folder: Mukwai saleni icakutambisha cene nangu cimo ica fipe pali ci
rockbox_step_usb_storage_folder: Mukwai suminisheni inshila ya kusungilamo USB pa {model} yenu, lyena saleni drive iyo ilemoneka
rockbox_step_usb_storage_mode: Mukwai suminisheni inshila ya kusungilamo ifya USB pa cibombelo cenu no kutinika Icakonkapo .
rockbox_themes_notice_body: Rockbox on Y1 no longer supports iPod classic (240p) themes from Rockbox.org. You'll have to use 360p Rockbox themes made for Y1. Click next to continue.
rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: Nga ca kuti {model} yenu tayatendeka, fumyeni USB, kwata batani lya maka pa 10s pa kuti mubweseshepo, kabili mutendeke ukubomba. Nangu ukubweseshamo programu wa kubalilapo.
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: Ici citabo cilolesha pa lwa kulanshanya kwa ADB (ukufika kuli masekondi 30). Nga ca kuti icipe casangwa, imitwe ilasendwa kabili umutambishi alatendeka ukubomba. Nga te ifyo, pita ku ntanshi ku Musango wa Kusungilamo uwa USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Ukutwala kwa ADB kwafilwa; ukubwelela ku Musango wa Kusungilamo uwa USB
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Ukusuntinkanya imitwe na ma fonti pa ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: Ukulolela icibombelo ca ADB... (ukufika kuli masekondi 30)
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Takuli icibombelo ca ADB icasangilwe muli ba sekondi 30; ukutwalilila ne Nshila ya Kusungilamo iya USB.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Kuti nomba mwafumyapo ukutamba no kusala umutwe mu Rockbox (Ifyakupanga > Ifyakupanga Umutwe).
rockbox_wizard_done_title: Imitwe ya 360p na ma fonti yabikwa!
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Takuli ADB iya babili iyasangwa ku app; ukutwalilila ne Nshila ya Kusungilamo iya USB.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Fumyeniko intambo ya USB.
2. Ukubweseshamo amaka ku cipe no kuleka citendeke ukubomba mu Rockbox.
3. Nga ca kuti Rockbox yatendeka ukubomba, bwekeshapo ukubika intambo ya USB, lyena tinikeni Ukutwalilila.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Ukusenda batani lya maka pa kuti mupeele amaka ku cipe cenu, ukubwekeshapo ukubika USB, no kusalapo Inshila ya Kusungilamo USB.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Ukusenda batani wa pa kati pa kuti ulenge Y1 yobe ukubomba, ukubwekeshapo ukubika USB, no kusala Inshila ya Kusungilamo USB.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Intampulo 1: Tampa nakabili ukutamba no kulundanya nakabili
rockbox_wizard_skip_adb: Lundukila ku Musango wa Kusungilamo uwa USB
rockbox_wizard_title: Ukupekanya Imitwe na Amafonti ya Kabokoshi ka Mabwe 360p
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Lekeni Inshila ya Kusungilamo USB pa cipe ca kutambishishapo pa kuti cimoneke nga ca kusendamapo.
2. Saleni folda YOSE pa cipe ca kutambapo pe samba (.akabokoshi ka mabwe, Inyimbo, Imitwe, nelyo umushila wa motoka, folda ya .akabokoshi ka mabwe iyafisama ilasangwa fye).
3. App ilasankanya imitwe ya 360p na ma fonti mu, ukulemba pa mafailo ayakwata ishina limo line.
rockbox_wizard_usb_title: Bikeni ukupitila mu nshila ya kusungilamo iya USB
rockbox_y1_theme_warning_prompt: Icibokoshi ca mabwe pa Y1 tacasuminisha imitwe ya iPod iya kale (240p) ukufuma ku cibokoshi ca mabwe.org - mufwile ukubomfya imitwe ya mabwe iya 360p iyapangwa ku Y1 - tinikeni pa numa pakuti mutwalilile
sel_back_to_online: ← Ukubwelela ku Sofutiweya wa pa Intaneti
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Bwelela ku Salenipo Sofutiweya pakuti mubuule cipya cipya nangu ukusenda programu wa pa kompyuta.
sel_install_tooltip: Bikeni programu wa mibombele uwasalilwe pa {lbl} yenu
sel_install_tooltip_generic: Bikeni programu uwasalapo pa cibombelo cenu
sel_instructions_below: Mukwai konkeni amafunde aya pe samba pakuti mubike iyi programu pa {lbl} yenu .
sel_keep_data_incompatible: Teti tusungile ifyebo fyenu pakuti tubike pantu ifibombelo fyenu ifya nomba tafileumfwana na Keep Ifyebo.
sel_local_rockbox_themes_option: Bikeni Amabokoshi ya Mabwe 360p Imitwe + Icipe ca Malembo
sel_multiple_scatters_error: Amapakiti ayengi aya fibombelo fyakubomfya nangu amafailo ayasalangana yasangilwe muli iyi folda/icibikilo. Mukwai saleni icibikilo nangula ifibikilo ifyakwatafye icipe cimo pa nshita imo.
sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: Uku kufumyapo kuli na failo ukucila pali imo iya kusansalikwa, eico Updater tekuti aishibe umusango umutambishi wenu alefwaya. Kapanga wa {software} kuti alekabila ukubwekeshapo ifya kupangapanga fyabo pa kuti abike fye failo imo iya kusansalikwa.
sel_no_release: Tapali ifyafuminemo ifyasangwa kuli iyi sofutiweya
sel_offline: Imitantikile ya pa intaneti tayasangwa pali ino nshita. Bomfyeni failo ya muncende yenu, nangu moneni ifyo mwasuntinkanya.
sel_offline_install: Bikeni ifibombelo fyakubomfya ukufuma pa .zip nangu .rar pa citabo cakutambishishamo amashiwi.
sel_offline_install_generic: Bikeni ifibombelo fyakubomfya ukufuma ku .zip/.rar ifyakusungilamo nelyo ifyakubomfya pa fibombelo fya MediaTek.
sel_only_local: Saleni .zip nangu .rar ifyakubomfya, nangu icikope / ukusansa kwa .txt, pakuti mubike ukwabula intaneti, takuli intaneti ilekabilwa. Ici cilabomba na cila cipe ca kutambishishamo amashiwi.
sel_only_local_generic: Saleni icipe ca mu ncende yenu (.zip, .rar) nangu icikope icikwetemo failo iyasalangana iya kubikamo ukwabula intaneti, ilabomba ne fibombelo fya MediaTek ifyalinga.
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Mukwai saleni .zip, .rar ifya kusunga, nangu failo iya kusansalikwa (*ukusansalikwa*.txt) mukati ka citabo ca fibombelo pakuti mubike ifibombelo ifyo mwasala pa {target} yenu.
sel_source_desc: Kopololanipo tusolobelo twa pa intaneti, nangula ukuleta icipe icamu ncende yenu.
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Mukwai fumyeniko USB, mubike amaka no kutendeka mu Rockbox umuku umo (eico citendeka ukubika mu citabo cakwe ica mukati), lyena fumyeniko USB no kusalapo 'Inshila ya Kusungilamo USB'.

Nga mwaumfwana, tinikeni pa Twalilileni pa kusala folda iili yonse pa cipe cenu.
sel_themepack_guidance_title: Lundanya icakutamba mu nshila ya kusungilamo iya USB
sel_themepack_prompt_body: Mwalangisha ukupanga akabokoshi ka mabwe aka 360p. Bushe kuti mwatemwa ukubika Iciputulwa ca Mutwe ica 360p pali ici cipe nomba?
sel_themepack_prompt_title: Bushe kuti mwabika akabokoshi ka mabwe 360p?
sel_themepack_select_folder: Saleni folda iili yonse pa cifulo ca kusungilamo icakutambishishapo icasuntinkanishiwa
sel_themepack_success: Iciputulwa ca mitwe ya Rockbox cabikwa bwino bwino pa cipe cenu!
sel_type_help_body:
Esheniko umusango wa Sofutiweya wa Nshila intanshi.

Nga ca kutila icipe cenu ica kufimbapo tacasuka pa numa ya kucibika, bikeni cimo ica fipusho fya Musango B.

Ifibombelo fya musango wa B nifyo ifyaishile ne misango ya fibombelo ifya ntanshi ukucila pali 2.0.
sel_type_help_tooltip: Esheniko umusango wa Sofutiweya wa Nshila intanshi. Nga ca kutila icipe cenu ica kufimbapo tacasuka pa numa ya kucibika, bikeni cimo ica fipusho fya Musango B. Ifibombelo fya musango wa B nifyo ifyaishile ne misango ya fibombelo ifya ntanshi ukucila pali 2.0.
sel_update_available: Pali ukuwamya kwa {software} ukwasangwa ku {model} yenu.
settings_240p_tip: Ifilanga ifikuulwa ifyo zip ya ROM yaba iyapusanako iya 240p. 240p ukupanga takwalinga ne fiputulwa fya Y1 pa Innioasis OS pe samba lya 3.0.7, eico Langisheni Ukupanga kwa Kale ukwa Rockbox kwasuminishiwa na yo.
settings_add_device_no_versions: Tapali imisango iyasangwa iya iyi programu pali ino nshita.
settings_add_device_type_hint: Umusango ni ukupitulukamo kwa cibombelo ca katamba. Abakubelenga aba musango umo wine kuti bapangilwa mu kwalula ukucila pali cimo — icakumwenako Umusango A na Umusango B — kabili programu apangwa kuli umo pali bene. Moneni icikope ca pa numa ya cipe ca kutamba; nga ca kuti tacipeele ishina lya musango, shileni ukusalapo kwa kubalilapo.
settings_advanced_desc: Ilanga inshila ya kubikamo, umusango wa kubikamo no kufumyapo ifipimo.
settings_allow_keep_data_any: Suminisheni Ukusunga Imitantikile ne Mishiwile pa kubika kwa programu onse
settings_allow_keep_data_any_desc: Ukucilapo icipusho ca kulinganya. Bomfyeni fye ici nga mwashininkisha ukuti icakutambisha cikatwalilila ukubomba ne mipangilwe ya ciko iya nomba ne fyakutambisha.
settings_arm64_driver_note: Ukwafwilisha kwa Windows ukwa ARM64 takweshiwe. Pa fipe fya kupangapanga ifya Snapdragon na RTX Spark, Zadig kuti abomfiwa ne fya kupangapanga ifya kupangapanga ifya kupangapanga ifya kupangapanga ifya kupangapanga ifya kupangapanga ifya kupangapanga ifya kupangapanga. Moneni ubutungulushi bwa ARM64 pa lwa ntampulo.
settings_cache_desc: Fumyapo ifipe ifya kopololwa no kufumyapo amafailo ya ROM pakuti pabe incende pali disk. Ilyashi lya kale ilya kubikamo no kubwekeshapo ifyo mwatemwa ifya kwibukisha fyalisungwa.
settings_checker_desc: Ukupekanya kompyuta yenu ukusuntinkanya ku cakutambishishapo cenu no kubikamo amasofutiweya ayapya ayashininkishiwa.
settings_checker_desc_advanced: Ukuceeceeta imitantikile ya Linux iya pa muulu iya cibombelo ca SP, ukufika ku USB, amapekanyo ya mulongo, ne fiputulwa fya mu citabo.
settings_checker_desc_friendly: Ukupekanya kompyuta yenu ukusuntinkanya ku cakutambishishapo cenu no kubikamo amasofutiweya ayapya ayashininkishiwa.
settings_checker_desc_installer: Ukupekanya kompyuta yenu ukusuntinkanya ku cakutambishishapo pakuti mukwate ifyakubwekeshapo.
settings_checker_group_advanced: Ukupima ifibombelo fya SP ne fibombelo
settings_driver_desc: Ilyo tamulabomfya app pa muku wa kubalilapo, mufwile ukubikapo umubomfi wa USB uwa MediaTek, e lyo mufwile ukutendeka ukubomfya kompyuta yenu.
settings_drivers_gate_body: Ukubika ifibombelo fya USB ifya MediaTek ni nshita imo ine, kabili Windows ilafibuula fye pa numa ya kutendeka cipya cipya. Ukufika ilyo fyonse fibili fyapwa, app kuti yafilwa ukusanga umutambishi wenu ilyo ukubika kwatendeka.
settings_enable_a5: Suminisheni ifibukisho fya kufumyapo ifya A5.
settings_filter_old_rockbox: Langisheni Amabokoshi ya Kale aya Mabwe
settings_filter_original_pre307: Langisheni Sofutiweya iya cine cine iyafuminemo iya kale ukucila pali 3.0.7
settings_firmware_up_to_date: Ifibombelo fyonse ifikonkwapo filebomfya ifibombelo ifipya ifyafumishiwapo!
settings_guided_install: Ntungulwile ukupitila mu kubika mu app
settings_guided_install_desc: Ici citabo cilaikala na imwe ukupitila mu kucileka, ukucibika, no kucibika.
settings_hide_donations_tip: Imeni ukufisa amakwebo na ifipusho fya kusangwilako pakuti mumoneke bwino.
settings_install_themes_desc: Nga ca kuti casuminishiwa, imitwe ya Rockbox ilasendwa ku Y1 panuma ya kubika Rockbox bwino.
settings_no_devices_tracked: Tapali ukubikwa kwa fibombelo ukwalembwa nomba. Flash icibombelo pakuti cikonke ukukonka umusango.
settings_not_installed: Tapali ukubika ukwalembwa nomba (ukwasungwa panuma ya kumwentula)
settings_notifications_desc: Langisheni ifishibisho fya mibombele pa fishibisho ne misango ya fipya pesamba. Ukucimfya kulasunga fyonse mukati ka app.
settings_notifications_unavailable: Ifishibisho fya mibombele tafisangwa pali iyi kompyuta.
settings_notifications_warning: Ifishibisho fya kucenjesha ne fya kucingililwa
settings_offline_mode_desc: Fiseni ubutantiko bwa cikaya ubwa pa mwela no kubikamo programu ukufuma ku ma fayelo ya mu ncende fye.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Ukufumya kwa Rockbox-Y1 ilyo 0.5 tailafika takwaumfwana ne fipe fya Y1 ifyashitishiwe pa numa ya mweshi wa Machi 2026 ne fipe fyabikwapo kale.

Ukumwesha icakupanga ica kale pali ifi ifibombelo kukacingilila ukutendeka.

Bushe nashininkisha ukuti mulefwaya ukulanga ifikuulwa fya kale ifya Rockbox?
settings_old_rockbox_warn_title: Ubusoko bwakulingana kwa kabokoshi ka mabwe
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Amasofutiweya ayafuminemo aya kale ukucila pali 3.0.7 tayakonkana na ma Y1 ayashitishiwa na Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Ukubika ifyakupanga ifya kale pali ifi ifiputulwa kukaficingilila ukufuma ku kutendeka ukufikila umusango upya ukabikwa nakabili.

Bushe nashininkisha ukuti mulefwaya ukulanga ifyakupangapanga ifya kale ukucila pali 3.0.7?
settings_reminders_desc: Tukamweba ilyo umusango upya uwa programu wa citabo cenu ukafuma.
settings_reminders_desc_bg_menu_bar: Tukamwishibisha ukupitila mu fishibisho fya mibombele nangula ilyo mwaisala pa menyu ilyo ifipya nangu ifishibisho fya cikaya fyasangwa ku basambi benu.
settings_reminders_desc_bg_system_tray: Tukamwishibisha ukupitila mu fishibisho fya mibombele nangula ilyo mwaisala pa cipe ca mibombele ilyo ifipya nangu ifishibisho fya cikaya fyasangwa ku basambi benu.
settings_reminders_desc_in_app: Tukamweba muli app ilyo ifipya nangu ifishibisho fya cikaya fyasangwa ku basambi benu.
settings_reminders_enable: Njebeleni pa fyakubwekeshapo ifipya ku katamba wandi
settings_reminders_tracked: Tukamweba nga cakuti kwaba ukuwamya kwa {software} pa {devices} yenu.
settings_reminders_tracked_multi: Tukamweba ilyo imisango ipya iya ifi ikafuma.
settings_reminders_tracked_multi_bg_menu: Tukamwishibisha ukupitila mu fishibisho fya mibombele nangula ilyo mwaisala pa menyu ilyo imisango ipya iya ifi ikafuma.
settings_reminders_tracked_multi_bg_syst: Tukamwishibisha ukupitila mu fishibisho fya mibombele nangula ilyo mwaisala pa cipe ca mibombele ilyo imisango ipya iya ifi ikafuma.
settings_reminders_tracked_multi_in_app: Tukamweba muli app ilyo imisango ipya iya ifi ikafuma.
settings_reminders_tracked_named: Tukamweba ilyo umusango upya uwa {software} ukafuma ku {model} wenu.
settings_reminders_tracked_named_bg_menu: Tukamwishibisha ukupitila mu fishibisho fya mibombele nangula ilyo mwaisala pa menyu ilyo umusango upya uwa {software} wafumine ku {model} wenu.
settings_reminders_tracked_named_bg_syst: Tukamwishibisha ukupitila mu fishibisho fya mu citabo nangula ilyo mwaisala pa cipe ca mu citabo ilyo umusango upya uwa {software} wafumine ku {model} wenu.
settings_reminders_tracked_named_in_app: Tukamweba mu app ilyo umusango upya uwa {software} ukafuma ku {model} wenu.
settings_reminders_tracked_original: Tukamweba ilyo umusango upya uwa programu wa {model} wenu ukafuma.

settings_reminders_tracked_original_bg_s: Tukamwishibisha ukupitila mu fishibisho fya mu citabo nangula ilyo mwaisala pa cipe ca mu citabo ilyo umusango upya uwa programu wa {model} wenu wafuma.
settings_reminders_tracked_original_in_a: Tukamweba muli app ilyo umusango upya uwa programu wa {model} wenu ukafuma.
settings_rockbox_desc: Ibomfiwa ilyo mulefwailisha ifyafuma mu mapulogalamu.
settings_run_as_admin_desc: Busheni Windows pa lwa nsambu sha butungulushi ilyo ukubika kwatendeka. SP Flash Icibombelo na MTKClient lyene ukubomba no kufikapo konse, inshila ya kupwishishamo amafya ilyo umubomfi wa motoka nelyo icifulo ca kusendamamo akaana ukuisula.
settings_run_as_admin_restart_needed: Icipya cifwile ukutendeka nakabili pakuti ifibikilwe fibombe na ifi insambu.
settings_run_as_superuser_desc: Ukubomfya ukubika ne nsambu sha mishi ukupitila muli pkexec. Ubomfye ilyo ububifi bwa kusuminisha bwacingilila icibombelo ca flash.
settings_run_in_background_desc: Sunga app mu menyu nelyo mu cipe ca fipe panuma ya kwisala iwindo, pakuti ucili ulepokelela ifishibisho fyakubwekeshapo ifya app ne fyakutambisha. Ukucima: ukufunga iwindo kulafumyapo app.
settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Sunga app mu menyu panuma ya kwisala iwindo, pakuti ucili ulepokelela ifishibisho fyakubwekeshapo app na ifibombelo fyakutambisha. Ukucileka: ukufunga iwindo kulafumyapo app.
settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Sunga app mu cipe ca mibombele panuma ya kwisala iwindo, pakuti ucili ulepokelela ifishibisho fyakubwekeshapo app na ifibombelo fyakutambisha. Ukucileka: ukufunga iwindo kulafumyapo app.
settings_skip_install_donations: Luba ukufwaya ukusangwilako panuma ya kubika
settings_skip_install_donations_tip: Langisheni ifyebo fyayanguka ifya kupwisha ukwabula ukulomba ifya kusangwilako panuma ya kufimba.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Kusalapo. Ifishinka fimo ifya MediaTek filakaana ukumoneka ukufikila ilyo Icibombelo ca Kubomfya Ica SP cipeelwa fayelo ya kushininkisha (.auth); ukulundapo ifyako pano nga ca kuti icibombelo cilekabila cimo.
settings_sp_gui_desc: Ukufunga Umubomfi wa Kubwekeshapo no kwisula GUI ya Cibombelo ca SP Flash ne fayelo ya kusabankanya iyasalilwe ne fikope fya kupaatukanya ifyabikwa kale.
settings_sp_gui_install: Bikeni mu GUI iya cibombelo ca SP
settings_terminal_desc: Ibomfya ukubika kwa programu wenu mu cifulo cakubikamo pakuti mwingamona amashiwi ayasuma pafyo ifintu fileenda.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Ibomfya ukubika kwa programu wenu mu Mafunde pakuti mwingamona amashiwi ayasuma pafyo mulecita.
settings_terminal_install: Bikeni ukufuma pa windo lya kulekelesha
settings_themes_refresh_done: Imitwe na ma fonti fyaliba ifya nomba.
settings_themes_refresh_failed: Tacakwete amaka ya kubwesha; imitwe yasuminishiwa icilipo.
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_toggle: Remind me about multiple releases on a single model
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
simulated_mac_body: MTKClient aba inshila fye imo iya kubikamo kabili ifishinka fya macOS filalangishiwa. Umubomfi wa afwile ukutendeka nakabili pakuti abomfye ici.
simulated_mac_body_mediatek: MTKClient aba inshila fye imo iya kubikamo kabili ifishinka fya macOS filalangishiwa. Umubomfi wa MediaTek afwile ukutendeka nakabili pakuti abomfye ici.
simulated_mac_title: Cinjeni ku Musango wa macOS uwapashanya
single_instance_body: Kopi imbi yaliisuka, nelyo icili ilebomba mu nshita ya ku numa. Amakope yabili kuti yacimfyanya pa lwa kulanshanya kwa USB ukwa katamba, e co uyu umo takatendeke.
single_instance_busy_body: Kope ilebomba ni ukubika programu nelyo ukulanda no uletamba, eico ukucipwisha nomba kuti kwapumfyanya ifyo. Uku kutendekelako kukapwa; bomfyeni iwindo ililiko nelyo icikope ca iko ica menyu ilyo ukubika kwapwa.
single_instance_focus_failed: Kopi iyalebomba tayaswike ukulomba kwa kulanga iwindo lya iko. Kuti caba icapamfiwa nelyo icalembwa. Ukupatikisha ukucileka kukapumfyanya fyonse ifyo cilebika.
single_instance_force_failed: Kopi iyalebomba tayapwishiwe. Lekeni mwe bene, lyena mutendeke ukubwekeshapo na kabili.
single_instance_force_quit: Ukupatikisha Ukuleka no Kutendeka Na kabili
sp_auth_missing_file: Fayilo ya kushininkisha tayasangilwe ({path}); ukubengeshima ukwabula iyo.
sp_config_missing_platform: Fayelo ya kusansalikwa tayabilisha icifulo ca iko, eico ukupanga kwa console ukwa fayelo ya kushininkisha te kuti kukuulwe; ukubengeshima ukwabula iyo.

sp_gui_error_desc: Cafilwa ukutendeka GUI iya cibombelo ca SP:
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI will now open with your firmware preloaded.

• In SP Flash Tool, select "Download" from the dropdown box.
• Click the "Download" button.
• Make sure your {device} is powered off and disconnected.
{hint}
• Connect the USB cable to your computer after clicking Download.

Click OK to launch SP Flash Tool and exit Updater.
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Bikeni ukupitila mu cibombelo ca SP GUI
sp_gui_launch_intro:
GUI iya cibombelo ca SP nomba ikatendeka.

• Nga ca kuti tacifuminepo, fumyenipo amaka pa cipe cenu.
• Nga ca kuti calikwata USB, mufwile ukucifumyapo intanshi.
• Mu Cibombelo ca SP, tinikeni pa Kukopa.

Lyena lunganika intambo ya USB pa kuti itendeke ukubengeshima.
sp_gui_no_cached_firmware: Tapali ubupe bwa fibombelo ifyabikwa ukufuma ku kwesha kwakubikamo ukwacifumapo ukwasangilwe, nangu ifikope fyakukansha ifilefwaikwa tafilipo. Mukwai saleni nelyo ukupoka programu uwafuminepo pa ntanshi ya kwisula Icibombelo ca SP Flash.
sp_gui_not_supported: Icipe ca SP ica kubomfya GUI cisangwa fye pa Windows kabili cisangwa fye pa fibombelo fya Linux (x86/x86_64).
sp_gui_preparing_firmware: Iciputulwa ca fipe fya kupangapanga tafyapwililike, ukucipoosa no kucifumya ilyo tamulaisula Icibombelo ca SP Flash.
sp_gui_prompt_steps_fmt:
• Nga ca kuti tacifuminepo, fumyeni amaka ya {label} yenu.
• Nga ca kuti calikwata USB, mufwile ukucifumyapo intanshi.
• Mu Cibombelo ca SP, tinikeni pa Kukopa.

Lyena lunganika intambo ya USB pa kuti itendeke ukubengeshima.
sp_search_restart: Tapali icibombelo nomba, ukufwaya nakabili (esheni {count}). Sunga icakutambishishapo icaimikwa no kucibika nga ca kuti wapeelwa.
status_app_reset_defaults: App naibweshiwa fyonse ku fikole fyabako, ifyakubikamo ifyakukopolola nafifumyapo, elyo necibukisho ca batiri cabweseshiwamo.
status_terminal_install: Ukubika ifunde lyaisulwa mwi windo lyenu ilya kulekelesha ({path}).
support_badge_freedom: Ubuntungwa bwa Kateya & Akabokoshi ka Mabwe
support_methods_subtitle: Saleni inshila mulefwaya iya kusangwilako. Cila ca bupe cilatungilila indalama sha kusenda, ukusunga, no kwesha ifibombelo.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis lyonse ilafumya ifipya ifyakubomfya ku basambi nga Y1 (ukubika amano ku fyakupitulukamo ifyafisama nga 6.0, 7.0, na 8.0) ifionaula ifibombelo ifya kale ukwabula ukubilikisha. Icabipisha ca kuti, incende yabo ilapeela ubusoko bwa zero kabili tayakwata ukufika ku fibombelo fya kale ifya kubomba pa kuti babwelelemo ukufuma ku cifulo ca fibumba. Umubomfi wa uwapya na mulimo wa Firmware wa Mutundu wa muntu balabuula ifiputulwa: tulasunga ROM yonse iya kale, ukushininkisha ukwalula kwa fipe fyenu, no kusunga umutambishi wenu ukubomba bwino.
support_story_1_headline: Nga ca kuti abapanga ifintu baleya pa ntanshi, abantu balakula.
support_story_1_item_1: Ukupususha Abakubelenga Abaonaika: Ukuceeceeta kwa bucingililo kulashininkisha ukuti ifipya ifipya tafyaonaula ifibombelo fya kale.
support_story_1_item_2: Ama ROM ayasungilwe: Ukulonganika kwakumanina ukwa fipe fyakupangapanga ifyakubalilapo Innioasis fyafumiishiwapo.
support_story_1_item_3: Iciputulwa ca nshita: Ifibombelo fyakubomfya fyonse ifya macOS, Linux, na Windows ifipaleneko.
support_story_1_item_4: Amano ya Fibombelo: Ukumona kwa board ukwaibela pa kuti lyonse mulepokelela icipe icalinga.
support_story_1_lead: Ukucingilila icibombelo cenu ukufuma ku mitego ya fibombelo ifishilandapo no kwalula ukwaonaika.
support_story_2_body: Ukukonka amasofutiweya ya Innioasis ayaishibikwa ilingi line cipilibula ukufwailisha pa fifulo fyakulonganinapo pakuti pabe ifisuntinkanishiwa ifya Google Drive ifyapwa, ifyakaniko fya makumbi ifya Baidu ifyafwa, na mafayilo ya zip ayafisama ayabula ifibombelo ifilemoneka. Twapangile inshila iyashininkishiwa, iyaibela iya kusendapo ifya SHA-256 iyashininkishiwa, ukubwekeshapo ukushibisha, no kubikamo ukwatungulwilwe intanshi-ku-ntanshi. Ifyakusangwilako fyenu filasunga ifyakukopolola no kusunga ifilenga ukuti ici cibeko ama-awala 24 cila bushiku, inshiku 365 mu mwaka.
support_story_2_headline: Tapali ifipe fya Google ifyaonaika. Tapali umulimo wa kutunganya. Fibombelo fye ifibomba.
support_story_2_item_1: CDN iyalungama iya bwangu bwangu: Ukukopolola ukwayanguka, ukwalungatana ukwabula imipaka ya kukopolola nelyo ukusuntinkanya ukwafwa.
support_story_2_item_2: Ukubwekeshapo Ifishibisho: Chenjesheni ilyo ifipya ififuma mu cilonganino nangu ifilungishiwa fyapwa.
support_story_2_item_3: Ukutungululwa Intampulo-ku-Ntampulo Ukubika: Ifishinka fya kumona ifyaumfwika filakutungulula muli fyonse ifyo watinika batani.
support_story_2_item_4: Icilonganino ca ndimi ishingi: Ici ciNgeleshi, iciChina, iciGerman, iciSpanish, iciFrench ne ciJapan.
support_story_2_lead: Imibombele ya cikaya iyayanguka, iyashininkishiwa iyo mwingashintililapo.
support_story_3_body: Sofutiwee wa pa fakitare uwa fipe alefuuta fye pa muulu wa fyo ifipe fyenu ifya Y1 nangu Y2 fingacita. Icilonganino cesu caletele Rockbox, inshila sha kubomfya ishipepuka, ukutamba kwa codec iya kuumfwa, ne mitwe ya kuitemenwa ku mweo. Tulashita imisango yalekanalekana iya fibombelo ukufuma mu cipe ku kwesha, ukubweseshamo injiniya, no kushininkisha ukubika konse. Ukutungilila Updater ukwabula ukupita mu mbali kulapeela indalama kuli ifi ifiputulwa fyakwesha no kwangufyanya ukupanga ifibombelo fyakubomfya.
support_story_3_headline: Ukufungulula amaka yonse aya musambi wenu uwa Innioasis.
support_story_3_item_1: Amabokoshi ya Rock aya kutinika fye kamo: Ukutamba kwa baumfwa ne mitwe ya pa lwabo iyabikwa mu masekondi ayanono.
support_story_3_item_2: Filimu ya cikaya: Ukuwamya kwa mabateri, UI iya busaka, no kwafwilisha kwa codec ya mashiwi aya nomba.
support_story_3_item_3: Lab ya fibombelo ifibomba: Tuleesha pa fibombelo fya cine cine ilyo tatulafumyapo ukupanga ukuli konse.
support_story_3_item_4: Icipe icakubomfya ukwabula ukulipila: 100% icabula ukulipila, icakubalilapo ica nkama ukwabula ukusabankanya nangu ukukonka.
support_story_3_lead: Ukuleta Rockbox, imibombele iyayanguka, no buntungwa bwa baumfwa.
support_story_4_body: Ilyo kampani ya fibombelo fyakubomfya yapita ku fibombelo fyabo ifyakonkapo, imisango ya kale ilalekeleshiwa. Innioasis tayapeela ubwafwilisho bwa Linux, tayakwata ifyakupilibula ifyaumfwika, kabili tayapeela inshila iyayanguka iyakubweseshamo ilyo ukubika kwafilwa. Updater alipo pantu ababomfya abacincila tabafwile ukuposa icakutambishishapo inyimbo icisuma nga nshi. 100% iya fya kusangwilako fya cikaya fyaya bwangu bwangu mu kusunga ici cibombelo icaisulwa kuli onse.
support_story_4_headline: Tukwafweni ukucita ifyo aba Inshilashi tabacita.
support_story_4_item_1: Ukupususha & Ukufumyapo: Ukubweluluka ukwashininkishiwa kulapita nangula ilyo ifibombelo fyakaana ukutendeka.
support_story_4_item_2: Ukwafwilisha kwa Linux ukwa musango wa kubalilapo: Ukwafwilisha kwa MediaTek ukwakumanina ukubengeshima pa fipe fya Linux.
support_story_4_item_3: Ifilembo fyakupilibula ifyaumfwika: Ifilembo fyakufumyapo ifyalungama pakuti mwishibe bwino bwino ifyakupilibula.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Ukupeelwa Inkongole ku Mutundu: Kofi onse asunga icibikilo ca fitabo icaisulwa kabili icabula ukulipilisha kuli bonse.
support_story_4_lead: Ukusunga kwa fibombelo fyakubomfya ifya cikaya ukusunga ifibombelo fyenu ukufuma ku fifulo fyakupooselamo ifintu.
system_checker_desc: Ukushininkisha ukwakumanina ukwa bakwesha, ifiputulwa fya kernel, insambu, na ma laibulale ya nshita ya kubomba pa kushininkisha ukumwentula ukwashintililwapo.
system_checker_title: Icibombelo ca SP ica kufwailisha no kufwailisha
terminal_hint_generic: • Icishinka: Bikeni icibombelo cenu mu musango wa kusendapo ifya kupangapanga (fipusana ukulingana ne misango: e.g., fumyenipo batiri no kuisunga ukufuma ne ntambo ya USB iyasuntinkanishiwa, nelyo ukucimfya amaka nga batiri yalibikwamo, nelyo ukusunga iciunda pa nshi/ukufika pa muulu ilyo mulesuntinkanya USB).
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Ica Kukonkapo: Nga ca kuti ifipe tafyalungama fye, tinikeni mu kuicefya batani wa kubweshapo mu cipe ca pin ne cipe ca kufimbapo amapepala ilyo mulelungama ku ntambo ya USB.
terminal_install_failed: Teti cifungule iwindo lya kulekelesha. Ifunde lya kubika lyalembelwe ku {path}.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Tapali failo ya kusansalikwa iyasangilwe muli ici cipe, kanshi tapali ifunde lya console ilyapangilwe.
terminal_install_no_tool: Takuli ukupanga icibombelo ca SP nelyo icifulo ca kwingililamo ica MTKClient icasangwa muli iyi nshila.
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} will now open running {method}.

• If it isn't already off, power off your {device}.
• If it is connected to USB, disconnect it first.
{hint}
• Connect your device to your computer when the {terminal_name} window has opened.

Click OK to launch and exit Updater.
themepack_card_desc: Ici cisanshamo imitwe iisuma iya cikaya, ifya ku numa ifya pa muulu, na ma fonti ayapangwa fye ku kulanga 360p.
themepack_card_title: Bikeni 360p Umutwe wa Kabokoshi ka Mabwe
themepack_complete: Iciputulwa ca mitwe cabikwa bwino bwino! Kuti nomba mwafumyapo umutwe wenu no kusalapo umutwe mu Rockbox (Ifyakupanga > Ifyakupanga Umutwe).
themepack_err_not_found: Tacingasanga nangu ukutendeka ubutungulushi bwa .rockbox pa cipe icasalilwe. Mukwai shininkisheni ukuti mwasala folda pa cakutambishapo.
themepack_installed_success: Iciputulwa ca mutwe wa 360p cabikwa bwino bwino!
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Langeni umutambishi wenu pa kusunga batani lya Maka.
2. Ilyo Rockbox yatendeka ukubomba, pongoleni intambo ya USB muli kompyuta yenu.
3. Nga ca kuti mwapeelwa pa cimonwa ca kutambapo, shininkisheni umusango wa kusungilamo USB pa kuti icipe cimoneke nga ca kutwalapo.
themepack_step1_title: Intampulo 1: Lundanya mu nshila ya kusungilamo USB
themepack_step2_desc: Pa mulandu wa kuti ifipe fya kubomfya (nga macOS) filafisa amafailo ya fishinka (nga .rockbox) pa mulandu wa kuti fyaba, kuti mwasala folda YOSE nelyo umushila wa motoka pa citabo cenu. Tukasanga nelyo ukupanga ubutungulushi bwa .rockbox kuli imwe.
themepack_step2_title: Intampulo 2: Saleni Folda Yonse pa Cipesha Amano .
